title: DeviceAuthSessionResponse
description: Session established response containing a short-lived bearer token and server mutual proof.

session_token.description: Short-lived opaque bearer token stored only in RAM with TTL.

server_michi_id.description: Server or receiver michi_id (43 chars base64url).

server_membership.description: Valid membership certificate of the server/receiver issued by the Home Root Authority proving membership in the same Home.

server_signature.description: Ed25519 confirmation signature by server completing mutual authentication (86 chars base64url).
